text:
tyler: Heads up — embed-service has a regressions spike on long requests, ~3% 5xx in canary. Need hotfix deploybot expedite.
deploybot: [DeployBot] action=propose_deploy priority=high service=embed-service image=embed-svc:3.2.1-hotfix-20260323 canary=true
mira: logs here https://logs.redwood/streams/embeds/abc123 — tail shows KV cache NPE during cold-warm paths
alex: what's the rollback plan if canary degrades?
tyler: rollback target is embed-svc:3.2.0 (tag stable-20260322). Manual rollback OK, auto-rollback threshold proposed below.
sam: impact dashboard: https://dash.redwood/embeds — visible customer errors; +1 for expedited.
jordan: oncall ack. can run preflight checks in ~10m and monitor SLOs live.
mira: draft release notes and checklist: https://docs.redwood/releases/embeds-hotfix-3.2.1
alex: request pinning strategy: pin canary to the hotfix tag for 30m, then promote if green. also confirm traffic % steps.
tyler: propose sequence: canary 10% -> 30m monitor -> 50% -> 20m -> 100%. Auto-rollback if error_rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m.
deploybot: [DeployBot] requesting approvals from @alex @mira @jordan — react with :white_check_mark: to approve expedited rollout.
alex: ✅ approve. agree with pin+promote and rollback threshold.
mira: ✅ approve, QA smoke test queued and ready.
jordan: ✅ oncall signed off, will watch latency & errors, ready to trigger rollback if needed.
deploybot: [DeployBot] scheduled rollout: canary=10% starting now. operator=tyler
sam: adding a kill-switch note: if token-latency p95 increases > 200ms or error_rate > 0.5%, trigger rollback and alert SRE.
tyler: got it, setting alert and kill-switch runbook now.
mira: I'll update release note with rollback steps and contact list.
deploybot: [DeployBot] canary roll started. canary_id=cb-1736543210 pid=9876
alex: seeing small cache-warm spike in errors, expected. monitoring.
jordan: tail latency stable, no backend timeouts.
sam: :thumbsup: good so far.
mira: QA smoke tests passed — hits basic read/write and long request flows.
deploybot: [DeployBot] promoting to 50% (phase=promote) — notified monitoring hooks
tyler: promoting to 50% now.
deploybot: [DeployBot] promotion complete. traffic=50% next check in 20m.
alex: looks clean from logs and traces.
jordan: still within SLOs. no rollback trigger.
sam: I'll update the release ticket TKT-4321 with timeline and notes.
mira: will publish release note after full rollout complete.
deploybot: [DeployBot] promoting to 100% at 1736543275 — rollout finished, no rollback triggered.
tyler: thanks all. leave the rollback window open for 60m post-100% per policy.
mira: will post final release note and link to ticket when window closes.
jordan: monitoring continues. closing thread for now unless alerts fire.
